meta.title: dsh remote go
meta.description: Use a remote DSH over SSH inside the local DSH: the desktop client fills the whole window with the remote UI and injects a host row at the top of the remote sidebar (current host / remote session / switch / reload / leave). The plugin installs its own Node under ~/.dsh/remote-go/node at the lower bound of DSH engines.node (never the system one), then launches the remote DSH with npx pinned to the local version; its data stays in the user’s own ~/.dsh. Host list, connection wizard, diagnostics and exact version parity included.
